create_idefics3_image_processor: create an Idefics3ImageProcessorPil instance to preprocess images for the Idefics3 multimodal model
preprocess_images_idefics3: preprocess a batch of PIL images for Idefics3 by resizing, splitting, normalizing, and padding to uniform tensors
split_images_into_patches: split a large image into patches when do_image_splitting is enabled and the image exceeds max_image_size
resize_images_for_vision_encoder: resize images to dimensions that are multiples of the vision encoder's max size for Idefics3
calculate_image_patch_count: calculate the number of image patches produced for a given image height, width, and processor kwargs
